import random, sys, resource, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import ref, planner
rng=random.Random(13)
for it in range(3):
    R=rng.randrange(7,9)

    decode=[rng.randrange(0,4) for _ in range(3)]

        print("  starts length mismatch -> skipping"); continue
    t=time.time()
    try:
        g=ref.brute_frontier(R,starts,q,bursts,cap,hit,miss,decode)
